method: POST /api/conversation/converse-stream (SSE), 5 billing questions x 3 reps per arm, same backend session, real Gradium-free path (text in, no STT/TTS), Mistral mistral-small-latest + Ollama nomic-embed-text + pgvector. Clean per-request weighting.
questions: Pourquoi ma facture de telephone est plus elevee que le mois dernier ?
Pouvez-vous m'expliquer en detail les differentes lignes qui composent le montant total de ma facture ?
Je souhaite comprendre pourquoi des frais supplementaires apparaissent sur mon releve ce mois.
Serait-il possible de mettre en place un echeancier pour etaler le paiement de ma facture ?
J'aimerais savoir comment resilier mon abonnement et connaitre les frais de resiliation associes.

quality.grounded: all turns grounded=true in both arms
quality.confidence: identical per question across arms (same top hits)
quality.regression: none on correctness; minor breadth trade-off (top-k=5 dropped the specific 3900 phone number on the payment answer, still correct)
quality.bug_003: no answer-bearing-chunk eviction observed on the fixture set; top-k=5 keeps a margin above the pre-BUG-003 value of 4

conclusion: top-k 8->5 halves backend first-token p95 (tail-dominated) with grounding preserved. Codified as the default (env-tunable). The mouth-to-ear ADR-0029 gate still FAILs end-to-end because the STT time-to-final tail (WEB-035) dominates and is highly variable; both levers are needed. LLM first-token remains the largest backend sub-slice and is model-inherent -> lever B (provider benchmark) tracked for an ADR.
